spell.name: Conjure Tools [5.5e]
spell.classes: School: Conjuration, Bard, Ranger, Wizard, Artificer, Bard [5.5e], Ranger [5.5e], Wizard [5.5e], Artificer [5.5e]
spell.text:
This spell creates a set of Artisan's Tools of your choice. You have proficiency with these tools. At the end of the spell's duration, the tools vanish, but any items created or transformed by the tools remain. The spell ends early if you cast it again or if the tools are more than 10 feet away from you.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. If cast with a level 3 spell slot, you work as efficiently as two characters when determining how much time it takes to craft nonmagical items using the tools.
Source: DND Beyond's September Drop: Magic Expanded and Phandalin's Return

spell.name: Feign Interest [5.5e]
spell.text:
This spell is a favorite of apprentices and students. For the duration, you appear to be fully focused and paying rapt attention. Behind the illusion, you can be napping, thinking about other things, or otherwise letting your mind wander. A creature that takes a Search action to evaluate your state of mind can determine that your interest is feigned with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, they see your true demeanor.
Source: DND Beyond's September Drop: Magic Expanded and Phandalin's Return

spell.name: Pinky Swear [5.5e]
spell.classes: School: Abjuration, Touch Spells, Bard, Paladin, Wizard, Bard [5.5e], Paladin [5.5e], Wizard [5.5e]
spell.text:
You touch a creature and speak a promise of no more than 25 words that you vow to keep. For the duration of the spell, if you knowingly break the promise, the target immediately knows of your breach if it is within 1 mile, and you start burning, taking 1 Fire damage at the start of each of your turns instead of the normal burning damage.
Source: DND Beyond's September Drop: Magic Expanded and Phandalin's Return

spell.name: Quick Clothier [5.5e]
spell.components: V, S, M (a set of clothing)
spell.classes: School: Transmutation, Touch Spells, Bard, Wizard, Artificer, Bard [5.5e], Wizard [5.5e], Artificer [5.5e]
spell.text:
You alter the appearance of a set of nonmagical clothing that isn't being worn by someone else. You determine the color, styling, decoration, and form the clothing takes, though you can't generate clothes worth more than 15 GP. For example, you could transform a tattered Robe into Fine Clothes, or vice versa. At the end of the spell's duration, the altered clothing returns to its original form.
Source: DND Beyond's September Drop: Magic Expanded and Phandalin's Return
